trades.title: Send Zavier: Purdy + Montgomery for Lawrence + Kyren + D. Smith
trades.why: Best move available to any Jacked Pine team: title odds about 18.8% to 24.3%, #1 seed 28% to 37.5%. Adds a QB plus RB and WR depth for byes.
trades.partner_reason: Zavier gets the best QB in the deal (Purdy) and consolidates his RB surplus; the market sees it as close to even for him.
trades.risk: You need one roster spot (3 for 2). johnlucamigaldi's best trade targets the same Lawrence and D. Smith, so send this first. Walk away if he asks for Jaxon Smith-Njigba or St. Brown.
trades.value_note: Claude model: acceptance about 78% (rough tier). Zavier's title odds drop from about 22% to 16%.

trades.title: Backup if Zavier declines: St. Brown + Daniels + Barkley for Flowers + Watson + Hubbard
trades.why: Title odds about 18.8% to 20.5% and lowers Chris, the favorite, from about 24% to 22%.
trades.partner_reason: Chris gets St. Brown, the best player in the deal, and a QB while Caleb Williams is out.
trades.risk: Costs St. Brown. Flowers is Questionable (hamstring). Only send if the Zavier deal fails.
trades.value_note: Claude model: acceptance very high (rough tier).
trades.confidence: Backup · do not send with Zavier offer open
